does: Loads a video by its name: finds the file of that name among the loaded mods and hands its path to the player's own loader, the virtual at slot 1 of the video manager.

evidence.says: copies the default string, calls the finder at bg3_dx11.exe+0x3CC15A0 with the name and the mod manager, and on success calls the manager's virtual at +8 with the path found
copies the default string, calls code:unplaced::FindVideoFile with the name and the mod manager, and on success calls the manager's virtual at +8 with the path found
